Title: The Flash Vol 3 2

URL Source: https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/The_Flash_Vol_3_2

Markdown Content:
****_The Flash_ (Volume 3) #2**** is an issue of the series [_The Flash _ (Volume  3)](/wiki/The_Flash_Vol_3 "The Flash Vol 3") with a cover date of [ July, 2010](/wiki/Category:2010,_July "Category:2010, July"). It was published on May 12, 2010.

## Synopsis for "Case One: The Dastardly Deaths of the Rogues"

The individuals dressed like the [Rogues](/wiki/Rogues "Rogues") reveal that they are called the [Renegades](/wiki/Renegades_(25th_Century) "Renegades (25th Century)") and have come from the future to arrest [Flash](/wiki/Barry_Allen_(New_Earth) "Barry Allen (New Earth)"). They continue to explain that he is under arrest for a crime that he will commit in the future, killing one of them, the [Mirror Monarch](/wiki/Mirror_Monarch_(New_Earth) "Mirror Monarch (New Earth)"). Flash will kill the Mirror Monarch several days from now and, presumably, travel back in time to leave the body in this time. After a chase, Flash manages to escape and goes to tell his wife, [Iris West](/wiki/Iris_West_(New_Earth) "Iris West (New Earth)"), what is going on. Iris suspects that [Professor Zoom](/wiki/Eobard_Thawne_(New_Earth) "Eobard Thawne (New Earth)") may be involved, but Barry is unsure.

In [Iron Heights](/wiki/Iron_Heights "Iron Heights") Prison, [Captain Boomerang](/wiki/George_Harkness_(New_Earth) "George Harkness (New Earth)") is being held in a high security prison. Suddenly, the guards are killed, causing him to investigate. He finds the reflections of [Captain Cold](/wiki/Leonard_Snart_(New_Earth) "Leonard Snart (New Earth)") and [Mirror Master](/wiki/Evan_McCulloch_(New_Earth) "Evan McCulloch (New Earth)") on the door. He is told by Captain Cold that he has repeatedly failed them, and that he must escape on his own.

Back at Police Headquarters, Barry is approached by a woman who claims that her son, Jason Hicks, has been wrongly charged with murder and no one will help her. Barry decides to take on the case despite that it has been closed with Jason having confessed. Soon, he learns that the police have found DNA on the murder victim who was dressed like Mirror Master. Barry is shocked when the DNA analysis comes back with a match. The DNA belongs to Barry Allen.

## Appearing in "Case One: The Dastardly Deaths of the Rogues"

**Featured Characters:**

*   [The Flash](/wiki/Barry_Allen_(New_Earth) "Barry Allen (New Earth)")
